## Description

"An integrated amplifier designed by Tim de Paravicini.It uses the newly developed EL519Enhanced Triode mode that ensures the sound quality and reliability of pure triode.The newly developed pre-stage DC coupling eliminates condensers that degrade sound quality from between stages.For the transformer, Tim de Paravicini himself winds up a special transformer which he has developed for several decades.The input is provided in the Line 5and can be used as an integrated amplifier or a power amplifier."
